items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And Verlon Page, who played the tuba, Big Page come in his place, you understand?

ctx.x: The Blue Devils broke up, but then when you all went into Basie's band, did his band get bigger, or did he --
No, that was the Benny Morton band. And Verlon Page, who played the tuba, Big Page come in his place, you understand?
